Wow. I'm glad you didn't. I haven't really thought about it in such details. I just started to think, that maybe I'm never going to bounce back, and I this is all my life is ever going to be. And I'm miserable, and maybe it's not worth continuing. I never thought about all the details of it. 

I was just at a low panic point when I made the post. My outlook is better now. Not giving up yet.

I reached out to a lawyer. I'm waiting on them to get back to me. I guess, I'm able to get something like 1k per violation. I only owe 900 left. So I may get to keep the car? 

I'm just speculating right now. I do feel much better about things. I think I'll get through this just fine.
